mechanism: Both drugs inhibit angiotensin II pathway (captopril via ACE inhibition, sacubitril via neprilysin inhibition leading to increased bradykinin and natriuretic peptides), resulting in additive hypotension, hyperkalemia risk, and angioedema.
action: Avoid concurrent use; sacubitril/valsartan is contraindicated with ACE inhibitors due to increased angioedema risk and excessive blood pressure reduction.
